source: Roma Capitale, Ufficio di Statistica, Annuario statistico 2022, Cap. 1 (01_Territorio_Annuario_2022.pdf), Tab. 1.3 — official toponymic codes, fetched 2026-09-02 via the Internet Archive because comune.roma.it and dati.comune.roma.it were unreachable from this network by urllib, curl and WebFetch alike. Cross-checked against it.wikipedia's Rioni di Roma, which reproduces the same 22 names in the same order with populations agreeing to the unit and cites the same PDF. The Annuario's table renders two names with a space after the apostrophe ("Sant' Eustachio", "Sant' Angelo"); this roster uses the standard closed form, which is what every other source and Roma Capitale's own prose use. Quartiere and zona codes come from the same Annuario chapter (urban and marine quartieri 201-235, suburbi 301/307-311, Agro romano zone 401-459). Roman numerals R.I-R.XXII do not appear in the Annuario table and are an inference from the identical ordering — universal in Italian usage, but inferred here.
scope_ruling: Rioni plus tier-1 quartieri, ruled 2026-09-02. The 22 rioni are legally clean — one instrument, one municipio, fixed since 1921 — but they are 15.47 of Rome's 1286.8 km2, and they exclude the Vatican, the Galleria Borghese, the catacombs, the Appian Way, EUR and Ostia. Eight outer units carrying documented visitor material are added. Roughly 20 further tier-2 units were ruled out: the research found their monument lists thin to parish churches, casali and unexcavated villas, the same yield collapse that took Queens from 111 candidates to 21. All 6 suburbi are out as a class, each defining itself by its namesake quartiere.
vatican_ruling: Vatican City is a sovereign state and is not a rione. It gets a standalone page claimed by no rione, the way Forest Park and Alley Pond Park were ruled to belong to no Queens neighborhood. Its own law was NOT researched and its museums are the highest-risk photo category, so it carries in_scope true but photos_allowed false pending separate research. The Lateran Treaty extraterritorial properties are a THIRD legal tier, not a border: Art. 15 grants the immunities of diplomatic headquarters on Italian soil, and visitors follow Italian law. They publish under the rione or quartiere they physically stand in, with their status stated. San Paolo fuori le Mura is the case that forces this — it sits in Q.X Ostiense, two kilometres outside the walls.
kind_note: A place's kind must be one of the thirteen the schema allows: museum, theater, restaurant, cafe, brewery, hotel, bnb, park, historic-site, amusement-park, shop, stadium, attraction. There is NO church, monument, square or bridge kind — waves 1 to 3 were briefed with an invented list and three Sallustiano churches shipped as kind "church", which the changeset rejected at seed time. Rome's churches are historic-site, which is what the other hundred-odd already were. Ethos.Seeds.RomeSeedDataTest asserts this against the schema itself rather than against a copy, so the two cannot drift.
evidence_ruling: No reachable Italian source states whether a given building is vincolato. Vincoli in Rete and the Catalogo generale — the only candidates for a per-property legal designation record, the role LPC reports played in the New York waves — are unreachable from this network. NO PAGE MAY CLAIM A DESIGNATION, PROTECTION STATUS OR LISTING DATE. Rome's geographic spine is stronger than New York's; its per-property evidential spine is weaker, and the corpus must not assume symmetry.

zones.name: Castro Pretorio
zones.note: Two Wikipedia pages disagree over whether a small portion falls in Municipio II; the scoping agent could not settle it. No page may state a municipio for Castro Pretorio until this is resolved.

zones.name: EUR
zones.draw: Palazzo della Civilta Italiana, Museo delle Civilta. NOTE: the Palazzo is a photo REJECT until 2043 — co-architect Giovanni Guerrini died 1972 and Italy has no freedom of panorama.

zones.name: Pinciano
zones.draw: Galleria Borghese, GNAM, Villa Giulia. State-museum interiors are the highest-risk photo class and need sign-off.

zones.name: Flaminio
zones.draw: MAXXI. NOTE: MAXXI is a photo REJECT — Zaha Hadid died 2016, protected to 2087.

zones.name: Parioli
zones.draw: Auditorium Parco della Musica — which the scoping brief wrongly placed in Flaminio. NOTE: photo REJECT, Renzo Piano is living.

zones.name: Ardeatino
zones.draw: Catacombs of San Callisto and San Sebastiano, Tre Fontane. The catacombs are in Ardeatino, NOT Appio-Latino as the brief assumed.

zones.name: Ostiense
zones.draw: San Paolo fuori le Mura (Lateran Treaty extraterritorial, published here per the vatican_ruling), Centrale Montemartini.

zones.name: Ostia Antica
zones.draw: The scavi and Museo Ostiense, 273,638 visitors in 2023. In Comune di Roma, Municipio X, zona urbanistica 13E. NOTE: this is Z.XXXV, a ZONA — Q.XXXV is Lido di Castel Fusano, a different unit. The Parco archeologico institute also covers sites in Fiumicino (Museo delle navi, Necropoli di Porto) which are NOT in Rome.

zones.name: Ostia Lido
zones.draw: Rome's beach. Spans the three marine quartieri Q.XXXIII-XXXV; the roster carries the first and any page must not claim the others.

zones.name: Vatican City
zones.note: Not a rione and claimed by none, per the vatican_ruling. Vatican law was not researched. St Peter's Square IS inside the state per Lateran Treaty Art. 3 — Italian policing there is a concession on foreign soil, not evidence of Italian territory. The border is defined only by a 1:5000 map annexed to the Treaty, with no verbal description; the 1932/33 bilateral border commission's conclusions were never ratified. The Ricciolo d'Italia, a 3m by 60m curl of Italian territory, runs behind the north colonnade. No page may state the boundary in terms more precise than the Treaty does.

out_of_scope_note: The 6 suburbi as a class; 11 post-war residential quartieri (Appio Claudio, San Basilio, Alessandrino, Monte Sacro Alto, Ponte Mammolo, Collatino, Prenestino-Centocelle, Pietralata, Primavalle, Giuliano-Dalmata, Don Bosco); 36 Agro romano zone. Also noted and deliberately not carried: traveller-known names such as Garbatella, Pigneto and San Lorenzo live at the zona urbanistica layer, not the quartiere layer, and Roma Capitale states outright that toponymic areas 'non hanno alcuna relazione con le aree urbanistiche ne amministrative'. A later wave may add them as their own unit type; this roster does not guess at their boundaries.
